question: Does the revenue in the spreadsheet match the annual report?

result.answer:
Yes, the revenue figures in the spreadsheets generally match the annual report, though the two spreadsheet files contain different row counts.

* Kestrel Outdoor Gear Ltd's annual report states that fiscal year 2025 revenue was 441.2 million and fiscal year 2024 revenue was 398.7 million [2].
* `kestrel_financials.csv` lists four matching rows for revenue: 310.00, 352.40, 398.70, and 441.20 [T1]. The latter two values match the annual report [2].
* `kestrel_statements.xlsx` lists three matching rows for value: 352.40, 398.70, and 441.20 [T2]. The latter two values also match the annual report [2].

2. Financial Highlights
Revenue for fiscal 2025 was $441.2 million, an increase of 10.7% from $398.7 million in fiscal 2024.
Gross profit rose to $198.2 million, and the gross margin improved to 44.9% from 43.6%, mainly
because raw-material prices fell in the second half of the year.
Operating expenses were $112.4 million, up from $101.6 million, driven by higher marketing spend
for the new Summit tent range. Net income was $61.9 million, compared with $52.3 million in fiscal
2024.
